# ml-multi-003

## Instruction
Predict the formatted_experience_level of job postings on LinkedIn based on job attributes such as title, description, company info, salary, location, and other features. Save the predicted experience level categories. Target variable: **formatted_experience_level** with 6 categories:
- Entry level
- Internship
- Associate
- Mid-Senior level
- Director
- Executive Training data: postings.csv (84,996 job postings with experience level labels)
Test data: test.csv (job postings without experience level - to be predicted)
